title: Proactive Road Safety Intervention in Australia: Predicting Risky Driving Hotspots from Connected Vehicle Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.16913v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Road safety monitoring has historically been reactive, relying on crash-record analysis after fatalities and injuries have already occurred. Proactive identification of high-risk locations and dangerous driving behaviour before incidents occur is a critical but underexplored challenge. This paper addresses this gap using connected vehicle telemetry data from Greater Sydney, Australia, to detect and forecast near-miss risky driving events at the Local Government Area (LGA) level. Risky driving is quantified through g-force thresholds (hard braking >0.6g, harsh cornering >0.47g, harsh acceleration >0.5g), and spatio-temporal heatmaps are constructed to identify high-risk zones. Eight predictive models are benchmarked across three families: ensemble learning (Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM), deep learning (LSTM, N-BEATS), and classical time-series methods (ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing, Prophet). translated_title: 澳大利亚主动式道路安全干预：从联网车辆数据预测危险驾驶热点
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16913v1 公告类型：新 摘要：道路安全监测历来是被动式的，依赖于事故发生后的伤亡记录分析。在事件发生前主动识别高风险位置和危险驾驶行为是一个关键但尚未充分探索的挑战。本文利用澳大利亚大悉尼地区的联网车辆遥测数据，在地方政府区域（LGA）层面检测和预测近乎事故的危险驾驶事件，以填补这一空白。危险驾驶通过重力加速度阈值量化（急刹车>0.6g、急转弯>0.47g、急加速>0.5g），并构建时空热力图以识别高风险区域。八种预测模型在三个家族中进行基准测试：集成学习（随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM）、深度学习（LSTM、N-BEATS）和经典时间序列方法（ARIMA、指数平滑、Prophet）。ARIMA实现了最低的平均绝对误差。
tldr: 本文利用联网车辆遥测数据，通过重力加速度阈值和时空热力图，在地方政府区域层面主动预测危险驾驶热点，并基准测试了八种预测模型，其中ARIMA表现最优。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages connected vehicle telemetry data to proactively predict risky driving hotspots at the Local Government Area level using g-force thresholds and spatio-temporal heatmaps, benchmarking eight predictive models with ARIMA achieving the best performance.
